summary: Real local MP4/avc1 H264 decoding with exact encoded-sample/PTS mapping, bounded owned native process, explicit timing/provenance declarations, PGM8 derivatives and existing session/index/excerpt bridge.

environment.decoder: bundled FFmpeg software h264, one thread
environment.fixtureEncoder: bundled libx264, one thread, CRF 18, medium, bframes=2:b-adapt=0:scenecut=0:keyint=30:threads=1
environment.loadedLibraryLocation: dladdr-checked wheel av/.dylibs; external/system codec libraries refused
environment.avcodecLicenseReported: LGPL version 3 or later; distribution and libx264 licensing review remains open
